legal.privacy.markdown:
## Controller and contact
This service is operated by {controller}. Contact email: {email}. This policy covers charts, readings, accounts and subscriptions on this site.
## Data and legal bases
We process email, display name, language and interface preferences, birth profiles, questions, charts and reports, feedback, and subscription identifiers and status. Birth dates, times, places and input snapshots are encrypted with AES-256-GCM; they are not sent to advertisers or placed in logs or URLs. We do not collect special-category data such as religious beliefs.
Charts, saved reports and account administration rely on performance of a contract; billing on contract and legal obligations; personalized ads on consent; and security logs on legitimate interests in preventing abuse. We send no marketing emails in this release. Some charts require birth details. Anonymous calculations remain in your browser without database storage.
## Recipients and international transfers
Google OAuth provides sign-in (openid, email and profile only); Google AdSense provides ads and consent management; Stripe handles payments; RevenueCat synchronizes user IDs, purchase identifiers and membership entitlements (no birth information); Cloudflare Workers hosts the service and applies rate limits; Cloudflare D1 stores the database; Cloudflare KV provides caching; Cloudflare Email Service sends account emails; and Sentry provides sanitized monitoring. Stripe handles card information; we do not store card numbers.
Data may be hosted or processed in the United States. We arrange transfer safeguards using applicable Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) and the EU–US Data Privacy Framework (DPF) for eligible recipients. Contact the controller for copies or details of applicable safeguards. We do not send birth information to Google advertising.
## Retention
- Accounts, profiles and reports: while the account exists; hard deletion within 7 days of soft deletion, with a policy maximum of 30 days for handling requests.
- Anonymous calculations: no database storage; stored only in your browser and removable by you.
- Share links: valid indefinitely by default, optionally 7 or 30 days; invalidated immediately on revocation or account deletion.
- Feedback: detached on account deletion; sanitized text retained for improvement unless you choose to delete your feedback too.
- Anonymous aggregate events: retained indefinitely without personal information.
- Sign-in sessions: up to 30 days; invalidated immediately on account deletion.
- Stripe objects: retained by Stripe under applicable tax and accounting requirements; locally we store IDs and status summaries only.
- Security logs: 30 days, enforced through Cloudflare/Sentry retention settings.
## Rights and complaints
You have rights of access, correction, erasure, restriction, objection, portability and withdrawal of consent. Account settings allow a JSON export once every 10 minutes or an account deletion request. Exports include decrypted profiles, your reports and a subscription summary. You may also contact us by email. Withdrawing consent does not affect the lawfulness of prior processing. You may complain to your local data protection authority. Where applicable, request EU or UK representative details from the controller.
## California and other US state residents
You may request knowledge, access, correction, deletion or portability and opt out of sale or sharing without discrimination. We do not sell your data for money; advertising may involve sharing as defined by state law. The footer Do Not Sell or Share link and account privacy settings reopen Google's US state message. Advertising must use Restricted Data Processing (RDP) and honor Global Privacy Control (GPC).
## Cookies and consent
Functional cookies support sessions, language, timezone and the age gate. Browser storage holds anonymous reports and disclaimer acknowledgements. Google advertising may use cookies governed by its certified CMP European regulations message (TCF v2.2) and US state regulations message. If you refuse personalized ads, Google honors your choice with non-personalized advertising. No ad script loads without ad configuration. We do not use GA4 or Meta Pixel. Other regions see a functional-cookie notice without a consent wall. Reopen the CMP from the footer or account settings.
## Age and rule-based readings
Terms are intended for users aged 18 and over. Known under-13 users are blocked from saving profiles and receiving ads, with a session age gate. Ages 13–17 receive only non-personalized ads with the under-age-of-consent flag. Readings use deterministic rules for entertainment and reflection, without GDPR Article 22 automated decisions producing legal or similarly significant effects.
legal.terms.markdown:
## Scope and age
This service is intended only for users aged 18 and over. Content is for entertainment, cultural learning and self-reflection, without guarantees of accuracy or outcomes or substitution for professional advice. You are responsible for your decisions. Do not use the service unlawfully, infringe privacy, abuse APIs or publish harmful content.
## Accounts and content
Protect your sign-in email and sessions, and submit only data you are entitled to process. Free accounts include ads and the latest 50 saved reports. Pro removes ads and unlocks unlimited history and all sharing templates. Report PDF export is available; fortunes two days ahead are planned for a later release. Service may be suspended for security, maintenance or unlawful abuse.
## Subscriptions and payments
Ad-free membership costs US$2.99 monthly or US$6.99 lifetime as a one-time payment; annual billing is discontinued; the price and taxes shown at Stripe Checkout govern your purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically. Change payment methods or cancel renewal anytime through Stripe Customer Portal. After monthly cancellation, access continues through the current period, then returns to free. Lifetime access has no expiry and remains after subscription cancellation or expiration. Cancel any existing monthly renewal separately after buying lifetime. Account deletion cancels the subscription immediately. Payments are non-refundable except for mandatory refund or withdrawal rights. Stripe sends receipts and invoices.
## Privacy, rights and responsibility
Birth information is encrypted. The privacy policy explains processing, retention, export and deletion rights. We do not provide medical, psychological, legal, financial or investment advice, promise wealth, health or relationship outcomes, or sell remedy services. To the extent allowed by law, continuous availability is not guaranteed. These terms do not exclude liability or consumer rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.
## Changes and contact
Material changes will be published on this site. For billing, privacy or other requests, contact {email}. Operator: {controller}.
legal.credits.markdown:
## Geographic data
Place search uses GeoNames (https://www.geonames.org/) under CC BY 4.0. Data is filtered and compressed; your current location is not collected as default input.
## Fonts
Noto Serif SC, Inter, Cinzel, Cormorant Garamond and LXGW WenKai use SIL Open Font License 1.1. Fonts are distributed through Fontsource or subset for Chinese; attributions and licenses are retained with assets.
## Images and sky
Tarot uses public-domain images from Pamela Colman Smith / Arthur Edward Waite's 1909 Rider–Waite–Smith deck, sourced from Wikimedia Commons and cropped and compressed. The sky uses Yale Bright Star Catalogue, fifth edition (CDS V/50), filtered for display.
## Software
Open-source dependencies retain their respective licenses. Build and CI checks use a license allowlist and prohibit GPL/AGPL dependencies.

export.legend.bazi: Legend: year, month, day and hour pillars read left to right. Colors identify Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water; each pillar lists its Ten God and hidden stems.

export.legend.qimen: Legend: the Lo Shu grid places south at the top. Each palace lists direction, deity, star and heaven stem, gate, then earth stem.
export.legend.tarot: Legend: positions follow the selected spread. Each card shows position, name and upright/reversed orientation; geometry is the print edition card marker.
export.legend.astrology: Legend: the outer ring shows the zodiac, the inner wheel houses and planets. Antique gold marks conjunctions, blue trines/sextiles, red squares/oppositions.
export.legend.vedic: Legend: fixed-sign South Indian charts show D1 outside and D9 in the center. The diagonal marks the ascendant; gold abbreviations identify planets.

journal.method: Pearson r (−1 to 1) compares the forecast total saved with your first entry against your actual mood. It needs at least 3 entries and variation in both values. Your streak counts backward from today or yesterday. Area matches mean the forecast stars equal your overall mood; all areas tied for the most matches are shown. They do not verify events in that area. These patterns support reflection, not claims about predictive accuracy or causation.
